about: Profession packs (queue profession-packs): what each kind of working life needs that a generic app misses: the licences and renewals that must never lapse, the risks and the cover that protects against them, how the income behaves and the tax route that usually fits, the next rung, and three systems that run without willpower. Paraphrased from public practice, verified on the date shown; rules differ by state, council and employer, so each pack says where to confirm. Not legal, tax or medical advice.
fields: A pack added later carries its own verified and review dates. On a renewal, src is the source read on that date; confirm names what nobody has verified yet and where to check it: show a confirm line to the person, never as a fact. global is the one line that holds when no country is assumed.

packs.title: Salaried, private sector

renewals.t: Tax regime choice declared to the employer
renewals.how: Compare both regimes on the Savings levers card, then declare before the first payroll of the year.

renewals.t: Health cover beyond the group policy
renewals.how: Group cover ends with the job: keep a personal policy (or a top-up) in force so a job change never leaves the family uncovered.

renewals.t: Form 16 and AIS checked against your own records
renewals.how: Before filing, match salary, TDS and interest in the AIS; ask HR to correct a mismatch early.

risks.t: Sudden job loss or a restructuring
risks.cover: Six months of essential costs in the emergency fund, a personal health policy, a CV and three referees kept current.

risks.t: Income concentrated in one employer and its stock
risks.cover: Sell vested stock on a fixed rule; keep no more than a small share of net worth in the employer.

income.pattern: Steady monthly salary with yearly bonus and stock; the step-ups come from moves, not tenure.
income.tax: Salary under the cheaper regime each year; employer NPS (up to the policy share of basic) is not taxed in the new regime.

ladder: Deep skill in one area, known for one result
Leads a team or a product with a number it owns
Owns a P&L or a function
Runs a business unit or the company

systems.name: Career moves on purpose
systems.step: Update the one-line result you delivered this quarter; message one person in your network
systems.review: Each year: is the next rung in sight, or is it time to move?

systems.name: The money floor
systems.step: The SIP and the emergency fund move before anything is spent
systems.reward: The North Star's redundancy part rises

systems.name: Recover from long days
systems.step: A two-minute shutdown: tomorrow's one task, then off
systems.review: Sunday: energy scores of the week

packs.confirm: Your employer's HR policies and the income-tax site

packs.title: Government and public sector

renewals.t: Annual property return to your department
renewals.how: Most services ask for an annual return of immovable property by a fixed date; keep the register of assets, loans and gifts current through the year so it takes minutes. Check your service rules for the date and the form.

renewals.t: Intimation or permission before buying or selling property, or large gifts
renewals.how: Conduct rules usually require prior intimation or sanction above a value: check yours before you sign anything.
Check the NPS statement (or GPF) for every month's contribution; raise a missing credit with the drawing office early.

risks.t: Transfers and postings that split the family
risks.cover: A family plan for schooling and a second home base; keep documents scanned and shared.

risks.t: Conduct-rule breaches by accident (side income, gifts, social media)
risks.cover: A one-page list of what needs permission; ask before, never after.

income.pattern: Steady pay with dearness allowance revisions and pay commissions; pension or NPS by rule.
income.tax: Salary; the new regime often wins unless home-loan interest and other deductions are large: compare each year.

ladder: Clears the probation and the first postings with a clean record
Leads a unit; known for one reform delivered
Heads a division or a district-level charge
Policy leadership

systems.name: The asset register that writes the annual return
systems.cue: Any purchase, sale, loan or gift
systems.step: One line in the register the same day
systems.reward: The annual return is ready in minutes
systems.review: Every January, before the return is due

systems.name: Ask before you act
systems.cue: Any side income, investment in a new asset class, or public writing
systems.step: Check the one-page list; send the intimation first

systems.name: Posting-proof family life
systems.step: The relocation checklist: school, health records, address changes
systems.reward: The move takes days, not months

packs.confirm: Your service's conduct rules and the drawing and disbursing office

packs.title: Doctors and clinicians

renewals.how: Your state medical (or dental) council sets the renewal period and the CME credit points needed; keep a running CME log so renewal is a formality. Check your council's current rule.
Renew before it lapses; match the cover to your specialty's risk and keep the policy where your practice can find it.

renewals.t: Clinic registrations and licences (if you run a practice)
renewals.how: Clinical establishment registration, biomedical waste authorisation, fire safety and, where used, radiation equipment licences: each has its own renewal date.

risks.t: A malpractice claim
risks.cover: Indemnity insurance sized to the specialty, consent records kept, a lawyer known in advance.

risks.t: Burnout and irregular sleep from on-call work
risks.cover: A recovery floor (sleep, one protected day), and the daily three kept tiny on call days.

risks.t: Income that stops when you stop working (in private practice)
risks.cover: Disability income cover and a larger emergency fund than a salaried person needs.

income.pattern: Salary in a hospital; in private practice, fees that rise with reputation and stop when you stop.
income.tax: Salary, or for a practice, professional income (the presumptive route may fit small practices: confirm with a chartered accountant).

ladder: Registered and trained; the first independent cases
Known for one procedure or condition
Leads a department or a practice with its own referrals
Teaches, publishes, or builds an institution

systems.name: CME without a scramble
systems.step: One line in the CME log with its credit points and certificate

systems.name: On-call recovery
systems.step: The recovery floor: sleep first, the daily three at their smallest

systems.name: Practice compliance calendar
systems.step: Every licence and insurance renewal dated in the calendar

packs.confirm: Your state medical or dental council, and your indemnity insurer

packs.title: Licensed professionals
covers: cyber law and digital forensics experts

renewals.how: Bar council, ICAI, IAI or the Council of Architecture: each has a yearly fee or a periodic certificate; pay early and keep the receipt.
Your body sets the hours or credits (often in multi-year blocks); log each session the day you attend.
Renew before it lapses; size it to the largest engagement you sign.

risks.t: A professional negligence claim
risks.cover: Indemnity insurance, engagement letters that cap scope, and files kept for the limitation period.

risks.t: A conflict of interest or an ethics complaint
risks.cover: A conflict check before every new client, recorded.

risks.t: Uneven income between big matters
risks.cover: Pay yourself a fixed monthly draw; keep six to nine months in reserve.

income.pattern: Salary in a firm, or fees and a share of profits as a partner; lumpy when you practise alone.
income.tax: Salary, or professional income (presumptive taxation may fit up to the limit when receipts are mostly by bank: confirm with a chartered accountant); GST registration above the services threshold.

ladder: Qualified and admitted; the first matters of your own
Known for one kind of matter
Partner or practice owner with your own clients
Leads a practice area or a firm

systems.name: CPE logged as you go
systems.step: One line in the log with hours and proof

systems.name: Conflict check before yes
systems.step: The two-minute conflict check, recorded

systems.name: A fixed monthly draw
systems.step: Move the draw to the household account; the rest stays in the reserve
systems.reward: The household runs on a steady income

packs.confirm: Your bar council, institute or council, and your indemnity insurer

packs.title: Founders and business owners
covers: owners of a family or small business

renewals.how: Since 31 March 2026 a director's KYC is filed once in three financial years, by 30 June of the year it falls due, not every year. A new mobile number, e-mail or address is still reported within 30 days. See your DIN's status on the MCA portal.
renewals.confirm: The due date in the notification itself (G.S.R. 943(E) of 31 December 2025): one secondary source says 30 September.

renewals.how: Financial statements (form AOC-4) within 30 days of the annual general meeting, and the annual return (MGT-7, or MGT-7A for a small company) within 60 days. A late form costs Rs 100 a day, with no upper limit.
A registered mark lasts ten years and can be renewed without end; the renewal can be filed up to a year before it expires. A missed renewal can remove the mark from the register.

renewals.t: Advance tax, four times a year
renewals.how: Pay your own and the business's advance tax by the due date of each instalment, from an account kept for tax.
renewals.confirm: The dates (15 June, 15 September, 15 December, 15 March) and the single 15 March instalment for the presumptive route: check the income-tax site.

renewals.t: GST returns and the state's own licences
renewals.how: GST returns on their monthly or quarterly rhythm; shops and establishments, professional tax and trade licences on the state's dates. Put each in the calendar once.
renewals.confirm: Your state's dates and which licences your business needs: your accountant or company secretary.

risks.t: A personal guarantee on a business loan
risks.cover: Know every guarantee you have signed; keep the home out of it where you can, and tell your family what is pledged.

risks.t: The business stops if you do
risks.cover: Term and disability cover in your own name, a key-person policy, and a one-page 'if I am away' note for the bank, the accountant and one trusted person.

risks.t: Household money and company money mixed
risks.cover: Separate accounts from day one, and a fixed monthly draw to the household.

risks.t: Most of the revenue from one customer
risks.cover: Watch the share of the largest customer each quarter; a second and a third before it passes half.

income.pattern: Little or nothing in the early years, then uneven: a salary from your own company, dividends, and one large sum if the business is sold.
income.tax: Salary and dividends from a company; business income for a proprietor or partner (the presumptive route may fit a small business: confirm the limits with a chartered accountant).

ladder: One paying customer who would be sad to lose you
Repeatable sales and a first hire
The business runs a week without you
It runs, and grows, under a team you chose

systems.name: The compliance calendar
systems.step: Every filing, licence and renewal of the year dated once, with the person who owns it
systems.reward: Nothing lapses, and no late fees

systems.name: A fixed monthly draw
systems.step: Move the draw to the household account; tax money to its own account
systems.reward: The household runs on a steady income
systems.review: Each quarter: can the draw rise?

systems.name: The week without you
systems.step: Write down one thing only you can do, and hand it to someone
systems.reward: The list of things only you can do gets shorter
systems.review: Each quarter: take two days fully off and see what broke

packs.global: Company filings, director duties and tax dates are set by each country: keep the three systems, and take the dates from your own registrar and tax office.
packs.confirm: Your chartered accountant or company secretary, and the MCA and GST portals

packs.title: Investors and finance professionals

renewals.how: Most NISM certificates (investment adviser, research analyst and others) last three years. Renew before the date, by the renewal exam or the continuing-education programme your series allows; a lapsed certificate can stop you doing the work.
renewals.confirm: A 2026 change lets SEBI set a different period for a certificate: check yours on the NISM site.

renewals.how: The ARN runs for three years and ends on the same date as your NISM V-A certificate. Renew the certificate first (up to 12 months early); commission is held back while an ARN is expired.

renewals.t: Your own trades, under your firm's insider-trading code
renewals.how: If you are a designated person: ask for pre-clearance above the firm's limit, trade within seven trading days of getting it, never while the window is closed, and make no opposite trade within six months. Your close family is covered too.
renewals.confirm: Your own firm's limits and its yearly holdings statement: the compliance officer.

renewals.t: Advance tax on gains and bonus
renewals.how: A large gain or bonus mid-year changes the advance tax due: work it out the week it lands, not in March.
renewals.confirm: The instalment dates and the current capital-gains rates: the income-tax site.

risks.t: A rule broken by accident (a personal trade, a gift, a message on the wrong channel)
risks.cover: A one-page list of what needs clearance; ask before, never after; keep work talk on the approved channels.

risks.t: Job, bonus and savings all fall in the same market fall
risks.cover: A larger emergency fund than a salaried person needs, held in safe assets; never count an unpaid bonus as money.

risks.t: A short peak and an up-or-out ladder
risks.cover: Live on the fixed pay, save the variable pay, and keep a second skill warm.

income.pattern: Fixed pay plus a large, uncertain bonus or a share of profits (carry), often deferred for years.
income.tax: Salary for pay and bonus; capital gains for your own investments (the treatment of carry and deferred units is case by case: confirm with a chartered accountant).

ladder: Trusted with the analysis
Owns a book, a sector or a set of clients
Brings in the capital or the clients
Runs the fund, the desk or the firm

systems.name: Ask before you trade
systems.cue: Before any personal trade in a listed security
systems.step: Check the window and the list; send the pre-clearance first
systems.review: Each quarter: holdings statement matches the demat account

systems.name: Bonus on a rule
systems.step: A fixed split made the same day: tax, safe money, long-term investments, one treat
systems.reward: The North Star moves in one step

systems.name: Certificates that never lapse
systems.step: Book the renewal exam or the course that day
systems.review: Each January: every expiry date read once

packs.global: Other markets have their own licences and rules for personal trading (for example a yearly fee and ethics statement for a charter): the three systems hold everywhere; take the dates from your own regulator and firm.
packs.confirm: Your firm's compliance officer, and the SEBI, NISM and AMFI sites

packs.title: Aviation, defence and security services

renewals.how: A commercial pilot's medical is usually valid for twelve months, and six months once you are over 60 (or over 40 flying passengers single-pilot). Book the next one the day you pass this one.
renewals.confirm: The source states the international (ICAO) pattern; the DGCA's current medical rules decide your own period.

renewals.how: Since October 2023 a commercial or airline transport pilot licence is valid for ten years, not five. The ratings, proficiency checks and recent-flying needs on it have their own, much shorter dates.
renewals.confirm: The dates of your own checks, ratings and language test: your operator's training department.

renewals.t: Yearly medical, fitness and appraisal (the services)
renewals.how: Each service sets its own yearly medical, fitness tests and appraisal report. Keep your own copy of every result and date.
renewals.confirm: Nothing here is verified: your unit or service headquarters decides.

renewals.t: Permissions before travel abroad, property, side income or public writing
renewals.how: Conduct and security rules usually ask for permission first. Ask before, never after.
renewals.confirm: Your service's own rules; for a security service they are not public, so your own office is the only source.

risks.t: Losing the medical ends the flying income
risks.cover: Loss-of-licence cover sized to your pay, health kept as a system, and a second skill kept warm.

risks.t: A career that ends early by rule or by rank
risks.cover: A plan for the second career started ten years before the exit; a home base and children's schooling settled early.

risks.t: Postings, long absences and hazard
risks.cover: Papers scanned and shared, a spouse who can run every account, a will, and nominations checked each year.

risks.t: Fatigue from rosters and nights
risks.cover: The recovery floor: sleep first, the daily three at their smallest after a night duty.

income.pattern: Pilots: pay tied to hours flown and rank, high but only while the medical holds. The services: steady pay and allowances, a pension or NPS by rule, and an early exit.
income.tax: Salary; some service allowances and pensions have their own treatment (confirm with your pay office or a chartered accountant).

ladder: Qualified and trusted with the first independent duty
Commands an aircraft, a unit or a desk
Trains and checks others
Leads operations or a formation, then a second career

systems.name: Every expiry in one place
systems.cue: Passing any check, medical or test
systems.step: Write the next due date in the calendar the same day, with a reminder 60 days ahead
systems.reward: Nothing lapses and no duty is lost
systems.review: The 1st of each month: read the next three dates

systems.name: Recovery after a night or a long sector
systems.step: The recovery floor: sleep first, the daily three at their smallest

systems.name: The family can run without you
systems.cue: A posting order or a long roster
systems.step: The away checklist: accounts, papers, school, who to call
systems.reward: An absence costs nothing at home

packs.global: Licence and medical periods follow each country's aviation authority, and each force has its own rules: keep the three systems and take the dates from your own authority.
packs.confirm: The DGCA and your operator, or your own unit and pay office

packs.title: Short and uneven careers

renewals.t: Whereabouts filing (athletes in a testing pool)
renewals.how: If the anti-doping agency has put you in its registered testing pool, file where you will be for the next quarter by 31 December, 31 March, 30 June and 30 September, and update it when plans change.
renewals.confirm: How many late filings or missed tests in twelve months count as a violation: the agency's current rules.

renewals.t: Any medicine checked before you take it (athletes)
renewals.how: Check every medicine and supplement against the prohibited list first; ask for an exemption before treatment where one is needed.
renewals.confirm: The current prohibited list and the exemption form: the anti-doping agency.

renewals.t: Advance tax in a good year
renewals.how: A large fee or prize changes the tax due this year: set the tax share aside the day the money arrives.
renewals.confirm: The instalment dates: the income-tax site.

renewals.how: Write the end date and the notice date of every contract, agency agreement and guild or federation membership in the calendar the day you sign.
renewals.confirm: Your own contracts; your guild or federation for its fee and date.

risks.t: The earning years are few, and they come early
risks.cover: Pay yourself a fixed monthly amount from your own account in good years and bad; the rest is the fund for the decades after.

risks.t: An injury or illness ends it overnight
risks.cover: Personal accident and disability cover in your own name, health cover that does not depend on a team or a studio, and a second skill started early.

risks.t: Other people handle your money
risks.cover: Fees arrive in your own account; you sign payments; one independent accountant reads the books each year.

risks.t: Your name is the asset
risks.cover: A pause before posting; one person who reads a contract before you sign; your name and work registered where they can be.

income.pattern: Large sums at irregular times, a few peak years, then little: fees, prize money, royalties and endorsements.
income.tax: Professional income. Film artists may use the presumptive route (half of receipts taxed, for receipts up to Rs 50 lakh, or Rs 75 lakh when almost none is cash); an author's royalty has a deduction of up to Rs 3 lakh, in the old regime only. Whether either fits you: a chartered accountant.

ladder: Paid for the craft for the first time
A name people ask for
Chooses the work; others depend on it
Owns the work (rights, a company, a school) and earns after the peak

systems.name: A salary from yourself
systems.step: It lands in the holding account; a fixed amount moves to the household on the 1st; a tax share moves to its own account
systems.reward: The months of runway shown rise
systems.review: Each quarter: can the monthly amount hold for ten years?

systems.name: The second act, started early
systems.step: One small step on the skill or business that will pay after the peak

systems.name: Body and voice as the instrument
systems.cue: After every performance, match or deadline
systems.step: The recovery floor, and one line on how the body felt
systems.review: Monthly with a coach or a doctor

packs.global: Anti-doping whereabouts follow the world code everywhere; tax on fees and royalties differs by country and often by where you performed: ask an adviser before a foreign contract. A book's or song's rights last for the author's life and decades after (60 years in India) with no renewal.
packs.confirm: Your chartered accountant, your federation or guild, and the anti-doping agency

packs.title: Research and academia

renewals.how: A junior research fellowship award is valid for three years from its date: join a programme within it. The eligibility to teach as an assistant professor does not expire.
A patent lasts 20 years from filing, and only while its yearly fee is paid, starting with the third year. A missed fee has a six-month grace period at a higher cost; after that the patent lapses.
renewals.confirm: Who pays: you or your institution. Read your institution's policy on inventions.

renewals.t: Grant reports and the statement of money used
renewals.how: Each funder asks for a progress report and a certificate of how the money was used, by its own date; the next instalment waits for them. Put both in the calendar the day the grant starts.
renewals.confirm: Nothing here is verified: the dates are in your sanction letter.

renewals.how: Approvals for work with people, animals or hazardous material run for a fixed period and need a renewal or a yearly report.
renewals.confirm: Your institution's ethics committee sets the period.

renewals.how: Promotion asks for years of evidence (papers, teaching, students, grants). Add each item the day it happens.
renewals.confirm: The current scheme and its points: your university's rules.

risks.t: A post that lasts only as long as the grant
risks.cover: Know the end date of your funding; start the next application a year before it; six months of costs in the emergency fund.

risks.t: Long training on a low income
risks.cover: Start term and health cover and a small monthly investment during the fellowship years, not after.

risks.t: A paper questioned years later
risks.cover: Raw data, notebooks and approvals kept and backed up for as long as your field asks; authorship agreed in writing at the start.

risks.t: Who owns what you invent
risks.cover: Read the invention policy before you start, and before any consulting.

income.pattern: A fellowship or stipend, then a steady salary; consulting, honoraria and royalties on top, under the institution's rules.
income.tax: Salary; some fellowships and awards are not taxed (which ones: confirm with a chartered accountant); consulting is professional income.

ladder: A first paper that is truly yours
An independent line of work with its own funding
A group whose students go on to do well
Shapes the field, an institution or policy

systems.name: The record that writes the promotion file
systems.cue: Any paper, talk, grant, student or review
systems.step: One line in the record the same day, with its proof
systems.reward: The file is ready in minutes

systems.name: Deep work before the day starts
systems.cue: The first hour at the desk
systems.step: One protected block on the one paper or proposal that matters, before e-mail

systems.name: Funding a year ahead
systems.cue: Twelve months before any grant or contract ends
systems.step: Name the next two funders and the first deadline

packs.global: Fellowship terms, tenure clocks and visa dates differ by country and institution; a patent's 20 years and yearly fees are much the same worldwide, paid country by country.
packs.confirm: Your institution's research office, your funder's sanction letter and the patent office

packs.title: Technical specialists
covers: robotics, semiconductor, energy and industrial engineers

renewals.t: ISACA certificates (CISA, CISM and the family)
renewals.how: At least 20 hours of continuing education each year and 120 over three years, reported yearly with the maintenance fee.

renewals.t: Other certificates on a three-year cycle (security, cloud, project management)
renewals.how: Most ask for learning hours over a three-year cycle and a yearly fee; a vendor's cloud certificate usually needs a newer exam instead. Log each hour the day you earn it.
renewals.confirm: Nothing here is verified: read each body's own page for its hours, fee and date.

renewals.how: Valid for ten years, and only while it is listed on the Digital Sky platform.
renewals.confirm: The source is a copy of the Drone Rules, 2021 on a secondary site; one blog says five years. Check your certificate's own date on the Digital Sky platform.

renewals.how: Revalidate before it expires, with the sea time or refresher courses and the medical it asks for.
renewals.confirm: Nothing here is verified: the Directorate General of Shipping sets the period and the courses.

renewals.t: State and statutory licences (electrical supervisor, boiler, mines, safety officer and others)
renewals.how: Each board or inspectorate sets the period and the fee.
renewals.confirm: Your state's licensing board.

risks.t: The skill ages faster than the certificate
risks.cover: One skill a quarter, proved by something you built, not only a badge.

risks.t: On-call work and incidents wear you down
risks.cover: The recovery floor after a night incident, a real hand-over, and one protected day a week.

risks.t: Your sign-off makes you answerable
risks.cover: Put every risk you raised, and who accepted it, in writing the same day; know whether your employer's cover protects you by name.

risks.t: The employer paid for the certificate, and the record is tied to the work e-mail
risks.cover: Register every certificate under your own e-mail; keep paying the fee yourself between jobs.

income.pattern: A steady salary that rises with a rare skill; or contract and day-rate work that is higher but uneven; at sea, pay only for the months on board.
income.tax: Salary; for independent consulting, professional income (the presumptive route may fit: confirm with a chartered accountant). Seafarers: tax depends on days outside India in the year, so count them.

ladder: Trusted to run the system alone
The person asked when it is hard
Designs the system and sets the standard
Owns the risk or the platform for the whole organisation

systems.name: Learning hours without a scramble
systems.cue: Any course, talk, paper or thing built
systems.step: One line in the log with the hours and the proof
systems.review: Each quarter: on pace for the year's minimum?

systems.name: One skill a quarter
systems.cue: The first Monday of the quarter
systems.step: Name the skill and the small thing you will build with it
systems.reward: A list of things built grows
systems.review: The last Friday of the quarter: show it to one person

systems.name: Recover after an incident
systems.step: Hand over, write three lines while fresh, then the recovery floor
systems.reward: The streak survives a bad night

packs.global: The international certificates carry the same hours and fees in every country; a state or national licence does not travel: check it before you move.
packs.confirm: Each certifying body's own page, and your state board or maritime authority
